blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A city assessor from the Island Garden City of Samal (IGaCoS), cited on Tuesday matching market and assessed values as the basis for identifying a property listed in Vice President Sara Duterte’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN). Defense witness Engr. John Kenneth Enumerables was asked whether the 751-square-meter property corresponding to a Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT) ending in 3134 was the same property identified in the documents presented earlier, including its tax declaration and field appraisal report.
